Marco H: :thumbsup: I'll upload assets to shared drive.
Dana R: :thumbsup: I'll drop runbook draft by Apr 3.
Priya V: Owners: Marco = assets; Dana = SI runbook; Priya = rollout + partner comms. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.
